instruction: Use Vagrant with Consul service discovery
Configure Vagrant with Vault agent sidecar
Use Vagrant with Nomad cluster setup
output: echo 'config.vm.define "server" do |s| s.vm.provision "shell", inline: "nomad agent -server" end config.vm.define "client" do |c| c.vm.provision "shell", inline: "nomad agent -client" end' >> Vagrantfile

instruction: Create a cluster with K3s and Vagrant
output: echo 'Vagrant.configure("2") do |config| (1..3).each do |i| config.vm.define "node#{i}" do |n| n.vm.box = "ubuntu/jammy64" n.vm.provision "shell", inline: "curl -sfL https://get.k3s.io | sh -" end end end' > Vagrantfile

instruction: Use Vagrant with Kubernetes (kubeadm) multi-node
output: echo 'Vagrant.configure("2") do |config| config.vm.define "control" do |c| c.vm.box = "ubuntu/jammy64" c.vm.provision "shell", path: "scripts/control-plane.sh" end config.vm.define "worker" do |w| w.vm.box = "ubuntu/jammy64" w.vm.provision "shell", path: "scripts/worker.sh" end end' > Vagrantfile

instruction: Use Vagrant with Docker Compose inside the VM
Deploy a LAMP stack with Vagrant shell provisioning
output: echo 'config.vm.provision "shell", inline: <<-SHELL apt update apt install -y apache2 mysql-server php libapache2-mod-php systemctl enable apache2 SHELL' >> Vagrantfile

instruction: Deploy a MEAN stack with Vagrant provisioning
output: echo 'config.vm.provision "shell", inline: <<-SHELL curl -fsSL https://deb.nodesource.com/setup_20.x | bash - apt install -y nodejs mongodb-org npm SHELL' >> Vagrantfile
